message: FD AUDIT-FILE (line 24) has no inline 01 record; its record description comes from COPY AUDITLOG (line 27). The copybook record AUDIT-RECORD is linked by EXPANDS_COPY from the FILE section (SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0053-SEC-0003); no FILE record is registered for this program, so the copybook record carries no fd_name.
